notablePrerequisites: You control at least six multicolored permanents.
description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
When the Robots enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Robots.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer six times by tapping six Robots, adding six {U}.
Repeat.
